subject: [RFC PATCH 1/5] mm/page_alloc: count guard pages as free again when their buddy merges

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's page allocation system where guard pages are not being counted as free when their buddy merges. This causes the number of free pages reported by /proc/vmstat to fall behind the actual number of free pages on the system, leading to inaccurate reporting. The patch addresses this issue by counting guard pages under the merged block's migratetype when the buddy is cleared, ensuring that the free page count is accurate.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue in the Linux kernel's page allocation system where guard pages are not being counted as free when their buddy merges. This causes a discrepancy between the number of free pages reported by /proc/vmstat and /proc/buddyinfo. The patch fixes this by counting guard pages under the merged block's migratetype when the buddy is cleared, ensuring that NR_FREE_PAGES accurately reflects the number of free pages in the system.
